With these strategically located offices working in tandem, Coopers are able offer a unique platform to sell or let homes for their clients. Equally committed to Sales and Lettings, Coopers believe in operating in a proactive and transparent manner whilst maintaining integrity and professionalism. Coopers are determined their services should always conform to the highest standard and this is reflected in their membership to the National Association of Estate Agents (NAEA) and The Association of the Residential Letting Agents (ARLA) and The Property Ombudsman (TPO). Coopers investment in the latest technology, unrivalled level of marketing and experienced team ensures their clients are happy and would use their services again. This is echoed by their ranking on All Agents, the Trip Advisor of estate agencies where they are ranked within the top 50 estate agents in the UK. With one of three Partners of the company looking after each client a personal service is always assured with Coopers. Our Ruislip office covers the areas of Ruislip, Ickenham, Eastcote, Pinner, Harefield and Northwood. We are delighted to announce that Coopers are multi-award winning agents after being presented with two Gold Awards at The Lettings Agency of the Year Awards 2016 in association with The Sunday Times, Best Medium South East Letting Agency and Best Medium Letting Agency in the UK. Coopers also won the Silver Award for the Best Small South East Lettings Agency in 2015 and Best Small London Lettings Agency in 2014.
